body: claimed: M3 issue-worker-high (mkinney fork) · 2026-11-14T06:13Z · worktree/branch issue/1635-stock-cross-drill (stacked on #1634) · plan: reproduce first; if a stock-source cross drill into a part posts unjudged, judge cross_part against the setup's parts (never fixtures); if it is already refused, re-rate and pin the refusal

Reproduced before any fix (on 881f7726). Setup: the #117 punched bar, r10, with an r2 cross hole plunging -X from (10, 0, 0), 6 mm deep. Stocks: an r20 bar and a 40 x 40 box, each aligned and turned a quarter about Z. Mill-turn and lathe benches. Op S1 takes its source from the stock.

- **Into the part** (the bar models no hole there): refused at generation on all four stocks. Nothing posted.
- **Legal: into the bar's own modelled hole, or through stock-only material (an r3 core):** ALSO refused on all four stocks, with the same words: "cross hole ... rapids into the finished part: the finished part stands in the drill's path". `cross_part` read the source's mesh, and off the stock that mesh is the stock itself, so the stock was judged as the solid to keep.
- **Lathe with a box stock:** refused because "this part cannot be read as turned". It was reading the box.

**Verdict:** no stock-source cross drill posted unjudged, so this is **not a P1**. It is a false refusal of legal programs with a misleading message, which is **P3** by the AGENTS.md table. Maintainer: please lower P1 to P3 if you agree. Agents only raise priority, so the P1 label stays until then.

Fixed anyway, because the fix was cheap. A stock-source cross drill is now the same chain a part-source cross drill drills in that raw stock:
- the setup's parts are the solid it measures, and the solid it keeps (`cross_part`, with each declared hole's wall excused about its own axis);
- the source stock is the raw material its mouths stand off.

Result: a hole into the part is refused by name ("the model has no hole there") on both stocks, and the legal holes post. Details and the mutation table are in `docs/decisions/1635-stock-cross-drill.md`.
